fort_rampart.label: Travancore fort rampart above the coast
fort_rampart.anchor: The parapet walk of a Travancore fort of rough red laterite blocks, its low wall standing just above the beach, looking down over coconut palms, a fishing village of palm-thatch huts and a long pale shore to the grey sea. Where visible at the specified distance, the few ships at anchor far offshore are small grey three-masted, square-rigged 18th-century Dutch East Indiamen with no readable flags; do not enlarge distant detail.
fort_rampart.absent: No European bastions, stone castle towers, glass lanterns or blue-coated soldiers on this wall; no more than a few ships, none close inshore or under full sail.
fort_rampart.time: overcast day under low clouds with dark grey underbellies, heavy windless haze

palm_lookout.label: Palm-trunk lookout tower on the shore
palm_lookout.anchor: A tall lookout of lashed palm trunks with a small rough platform at the top, standing among coconut palms at the head of the beach with the grey sea beyond. The boy stays high on the platform and the runner waits at its foot.
palm_lookout.absent: No masonry tower, lighthouse, flagpole, European buildings or ships close inshore; no principal characters.
palm_lookout.time: overcast day, heavy haze over the sea

fort_gate.label: Gate of the Travancore fort
fort_gate.anchor: A heavy timber gate in the red laterite wall of the Travancore fort under a small sloping tiled gatehouse roof, a sandy path running down from it toward the palms and the beach. Ibrahim stands just inside the gateway with his dripping cousin behind him.
fort_gate.absent: No European stonework, portcullis, glass lanterns or uniformed guards; the cousin has no coat and no scar, so he never reads as Ibrahim.

war_hall_anteroom.label: Anteroom of the Travancore war hall
war_hall_anteroom.anchor: A small anteroom beside the war hall: red laterite walls, a timber doorway and pillars under a sloping tiled roof, and a low wooden writing desk on a woven floor mat where Ramayyan sits cross-legged among bundles of palm-leaf manuscripts. Visitors stand or lean in the doorway; anyone seated sits on the mat.
war_hall_anteroom.absent: No chairs, benches, stools, raised European desk, paper books, quills or glass lamps; palm leaves carry only fine incised lines, never legible script.
war_hall_anteroom.time: grey overcast daylight from the doorway

pepper_ridge.label: Pepper ridge above terraced fields
pepper_ridge.anchor: A green ridge on Padmini Amma's lands above stepped paddy fields edged with earth bunds, where black pepper vines climb the trunks of living support trees with green berry spikes hanging. Villagers work among the vines below while Padmini walks barefoot along a bund.
pepper_ridge.absent: No pepper on poles, stakes or trellises, no neat plantation rows, no tea or coffee bushes and no foreign buildings.
pepper_ridge.time: morning light under high grey cloud

grain_room.label: Store room near the war hall
grain_room.anchor: A small laterite store room near the war hall, with stacked bolts of plain cotton cloth and woven baskets and wooden measures of rice, and the arms of soldiers' wives reaching in to receive them. Frame only Padmini's counting hands and the goods as described.
grain_room.absent: No scales with dials, marked sacks, coins, chairs or tables; no full figure or portrait of Padmini.
grain_room.time: afternoon light through a narrow doorway

estate_yard.label: Padmini Amma's estate yard and jackfruit tree
estate_yard.anchor: Padmini Amma's Nair tharavadu: a low, wide house with tiered roofs of curved country clay tiles, dark oiled beams and pillared verandahs, and in the yard a great jackfruit tree over a worn stone platform. Lamps are small brass or clay dishes with open wicks, and the riders' horse lines stand along the compound wall.
estate_yard.absent: No chairs or benches, and no stool except where the panel names one; no glass lanterns or lamp chimneys, no stone palace and no foreign buildings.
estate_yard.time: night, one small brass oil lamp with an open wick set on the ground

wet_sand_beach.label: Tide line of the beach near Colachel
wet_sand_beach.anchor: A long flat beach of firm wet sand at the tide line, the shallow wash running over the hooves, coconut palms along the landward edge and the grey sea under low cloud. The horsemen walk in a long loose file: Madurai riders on tall heavy horses with lances, Maravar riders on smaller ponies.
wet_sand_beach.absent: No blue-coated soldiers, earthworks or boats drawn up on the sand, no ships close inshore, and no European saddles or uniforms on the riders.

fort_courtyard.label: Courtyard of the Travancore fort
fort_courtyard.anchor: The open beaten-earth courtyard inside the red laterite walls of the Travancore fort, under a tiled gatehouse roof. Nair footsoldiers sit on the ground in groups with matchlocks and powder flasks, round shields and swords stacked nearby.
fort_courtyard.absent: No coats, uniforms, tents, chairs, benches or stools, and no European drill formation.
fort_courtyard.time: late afternoon under low grey cloud

war_hall.label: Travancore coastal war hall
war_hall.anchor: The coastal Travancore war hall: timber pillars, a laterite base and a sloping tiled roof, the long side open toward the sea, and a low wooden table on which a hand-drawn cloth map lies weighted with pebble and shell tokens. The map shows coastline, rivers and hills as ink lines only; Ramayyan sits cross-legged on a floor mat at the end of the table while the others stand.
war_hall.absent: No lettering, place names, compass rose or grid on the map, no throne, chairs or stools, no glass lamps, and no turban, crest or headband on Varma.
war_hall.time: late afternoon grey light from the open seaward side

war_hall_evening.label: Travancore coastal war hall by lamplight
war_hall_evening.anchor: The same coastal Travancore war hall: timber pillars, a laterite base and a sloping tiled roof, the long side open to the dark sea, and the low wooden table with the hand-drawn cloth map weighted by pebble and shell tokens and one small copper coin on the coast. The map shows coastline, rivers, hills and the inland road as ink lines only; Ramayyan sits cross-legged on a floor mat at the end of the table while the others stand.
war_hall_evening.absent: No lettering, place names, compass rose or grid on the map, no readable face on the coin, no throne, chairs or stools, no glass lamps, and no turban, crest or headband on Varma.
war_hall_evening.time: evening, small brass oil lamps with open wicks newly lit

ghat_cart_road.label: Ghat pass cart road inland
ghat_cart_road.anchor: A rutted red-earth cart road climbing a forested Western Ghats pass, with a line of bullock carts on solid wooden wheels heaped with coarse pepper sacks and Syrian Christian merchants in white mundu and shoulder cloths walking beside them. Far behind and below lies a strip of empty grey sea.
ghat_cart_road.absent: No ships, harbour, war hall, map or principal characters; no spoked European wagons and no horses in the traces.

colachel_shore_memory.label: Colachel shore in memory
colachel_shore_memory.anchor: Colachel in memory: a fishing town of palm-thatched and tiled roofs behind a broad beach, dunes and coconut forest inland, and the Dutch fleet offshore as small dark hulls. Where soldiers appear, the VOC men wear blue coats with tricornes and muskets, and the Travancore Nair soldiers are bare-chested in white mundus tied short with front topknots and matchlocks.
colachel_shore_memory.absent: No bodies, blood or close violence, no red coats, no finished stone fort on the beach, and no present-day war hall or principal characters.
colachel_shore_memory.time: desaturated memory daylight under a smoke-grey sky

tengapattanam_memory.label: Tengapattanam shore in memory
tengapattanam_memory.anchor: Tengapattanam seen from the shore at a great distance: burned palm-thatch houses and a scorched tiled temple roof still smoking, and a single longboat pulling out toward an anchored ship with small huddled shapes of women and children in it, oars rising.
tengapattanam_memory.absent: Nothing close: no faces, bodies, blood, ropes or chains in view, no red coats and no principal characters.
tengapattanam_memory.time: desaturated memory daylight, smoke drifting over the water

dutch_camp_memory.label: Half-built Dutch fort at Colachel in memory
dutch_camp_memory.anchor: The unfinished Dutch fort on the Colachel beach in memory: mud and sand bastions slumping under their cannon with earth sliding off, provision sacks rotting in the open and sick blue-coated soldiers lying in thin shade. Seen from the beach, the departing fleet stands out to sea under full sail while a thin line of VOC soldiers in blue coats watches beside the unfinished wall.
dutch_camp_memory.absent: No finished stone fortress, no red coats, no bodies or blood, no Travancore figures inside the walls, and any flag only plain red, white and blue horizontal bands with no monogram.
dutch_camp_memory.time: desaturated memory daylight, heavy and humid

night_sea.label: Night sea between the Dutch hulls
night_sea.anchor: The black sea at night, where Mukkuvar kattumaram log rafts of three to five rough logs lashed together ride low in the water, fishermen kneeling and paddling, slipping between the dark hulls of anchored Dutch East Indiamen.
night_sea.absent: No sails or lights on the rafts, no outrigger canoes or plank rowing boats, and no war hall, map or principal characters.
night_sea.time: night, faint starlight on the water

temple_puja.label: Kerala temple near the fort
temple_puja.anchor: A Kerala temple near the fort: a red laterite outer wall lined with long rows of small brass and clay oil lamps, low sloping tiled roofs on timber posts, worn stone steps and an inner gateway. When the view turns seaward, the dark line of the sea lies beyond the palms and the few ships far out show only as tiny pinpricks of light.
temple_puja.absent: No tall stone gateway tower, glass lanterns or lamp chimneys, no visible ship hulls and no European buildings near the temple.
temple_puja.time: night in a thin drizzle, lit by rows of small oil lamps

grove_approach.label: Back of the estate toward the snake grove
grove_approach.anchor: The back of Padmini Amma's estate at night: raised wooden granaries on stone footings under tiled roofs, the servants' sleeping quarters, and beyond them a dense thicket of old trees looming like a dark island, its canopy swallowing the few stars.
grove_approach.absent: No glass lanterns, fences, foreign buildings or extra figures on the path.

sarpa_kavu.label: Sarpa Kavu, the snake grove
sarpa_kavu.anchor: The clearing at the heart of the Sarpa Kavu: roots coiling over the leaf litter like solid serpents, termite mounds rising like small stupas, and hundreds of weathered granite serpent idols, hoods spread, coiled singly and intertwined, beneath one massive tree. A single small oil lamp with an open wick burns at the foot of the largest idol; Nagoji is barefoot here, his boots left at the grove's edge.
sarpa_kavu.absent: No temple building or shrine roof, no painted or gilded idols, no glass lamp, no swept ground and no living snakes; no boots on Nagoji inside the grove.
sarpa_kavu.time: night, deep dark under the canopy, lit from below by the small lamp

sleeping_room.label: Dark room in the estate house
sleeping_room.anchor: A small dark room in Padmini Amma's estate house: laterite walls, timber rafters under the tiles and a woven mat on the floor where Nagoji lies, his rust-red turban set aside beside him.
sleeping_room.absent: No raised bed, chairs or glass lanterns, and no other sleeper in the room.
sleeping_room.time: night, almost dark, a faint grey at the shutter

dream_fragments.label: Three dream fragments
dream_fragments.anchor: Three remembered places in one panel, left to right: the damp curved wall of the Goa cellar with an iron bar across chained ankles and bandaged hands; black storm water where a rope tears through bandaged palms, its free end whipping loose; and wet sand under smoke where horsemen pound toward blue-coated VOC soldiers firing. Revathi appears only as a soft sorrowful face in the smoke of the third.
dream_fragments.absent: No noose and no rope near Keshavrao's neck or body, no blood or bodies, no red coats, and no present-day room or grove in the fragments.

dream_beach.label: Dream beach
dream_beach.anchor: An empty beach that is Colachel and not Colachel, the horizon tilted: on one side the dark silhouette of a fort, too tall and too close, on the other a flat glassy sea, with palms and blown sand streaming sideways in the wind. Nagoji stands alone.
dream_beach.absent: No other people, footprints, ships, flags or soldiers, and no recognisable detail on the fort silhouette.
dream_beach.time: desaturated dream light under a pale sky

character_notes.nagoji: Thick curled moustache; clean-shaven chin and jaw, smooth skin, no beard or facial scar; black hair with no grey yet. A tiny flush gold ear stud on the lobe with nothing hanging from it; in present scenes his sleeves stay down to the wrists and he is barefoot only inside the snake grove.
character_notes.varma: Face, moustache and build from his sheet, with black hair, never the grey of the sheet's later figure. In the war hall he is bare-headed with his hair in a side knot above the LEFT ear, bare-chested in a cream mundu with a gold border and gold necklaces: no turban, crest or headband and never a crown, whatever the sheet shows.
character_notes.ramayyan: Thin sharp features and receding hair, plain white cloth, palm-leaf bundle and stylus; no forehead marks or sacred thread, and never the officiating priest's face.
character_notes.padmini: Thick BLACK hair coiled at the nape with no grey; simple gold; a cream sari with a narrow gold border in the old Kerala drape with no stitched blouse, hitched for walking; long walking stick.
character_notes.revathi: Deep indigo sari with gold, never green here, with a shawl against the damp; jasmine in her braid, flat-coin necklace and gold armlets. The thin sandalwood line at the hairline is her only forehead mark: no red dot, no sindoor and no tali, for she is a widow.
character_notes.ibrahim: Short and broad, white turban, short grey-flecked beard and a thin pale scar from the anatomical LEFT ear to the jaw; short coat over a vest with bulging pockets, nothing on the forehead.
character_notes.dhanaji: Stockier and heavier than Nagoji, short black beard, white Maratha pagdi, indigo quilted tunic, no sash, talwar; never a rust-red turban.
character_notes.ponnan: Broad-shouldered Maravar, bare-headed with short curly hair, heavy jaw, thick moustache and clean chin; red shoulder cloth, short dark jacket and white mundu hitched to bare knees, on a smaller Maravar pony a head lower than Nagoji's mount.
character_notes.raza: Lean, hawk nose, pointed moustache and a puckered scar on his ANATOMICAL LEFT cheek, our right as he faces us; a deep green high-wrapped turban, the only green turban among the Madurai riders.
character_notes.mathoo: Older Syrian Christian merchant with grey receding hair, a fine grey moustache, white cloth and a prominent gold cross on his chest; a lay noble who never merges with Ramayyan's face or build.
character_notes.karl: Pale with a sickly yellow cast, cropped greying hair, bare head and a rough cotton shirt; no coat, uniform or hat.
character_notes.keshavrao: About nineteen, narrow shoulders, black hair hacked short, a faint moustache and grey-brown prisoner rags; no ear stud, no scar and no coat, so he never reads as Nagoji.
character_notes.kayal: Bay mare with an ochre red-brown coat, black mane, tail and lower legs and no white markings, sized between a Madurai charger and a Maravar pony.
character_notes.madurai_troop: Knee-length white jama tunics, plain cloth waistbands, loose trousers and high-wrapped turbans in bright white or off-white, never green, red or rust. Long bamboo lances with no pennons, quilted Indian saddles, and tall heavy horses in dark bay, dark brown or black, no greys.
